start.title: The Awakening
text: You wake up alone on a damaged space station drifting in silence. Emergency alarms pulse through the corridors as oxygen levels drop into critical range.
Something is wrong with the station's core systems. A faint unknown signal repeats in the background, interfering with normal diagnostics.

systemsRoom.title: In the Heart of the Station
text: You enter the maintenance corridor. The lights flicker violently as the station struggles to maintain power distribution.
Diagnostic screens show multiple failing subsystems. Life support instability is escalating faster than expected.

choices.text: Ignore warnings and attempt emergency AI reset

signalDeck.title: Signal Disruption
text: You arrive at the communications deck. A repeating unknown signal pulses through every speaker and console.
The station AI behaves erratically, flagging the signal as both a threat and a priority.

choices.text: Ignore the signal and stabilize systems
Send a distress call before stabilizing

rationing.title: Oxygen Rationing Protocol
text: Emergency oxygen rationing protocols are activated. Airflow across the station becomes noticeably restricted.
The environment grows more tense as automated systems redistribute remaining resources.

choices.text: Maintain strict rationing and lock overrides

advancedRepairs.title: Critical Repairs in Progress
text: You dedicate yourself to the most critical system repairs. Power surges ripple through the station as you bypass damaged components.
The core reactor begins to stabilize, but the strain is immense. Warning indicators flash across every screen.

choices.text: Push the reactor to maximum output

powerRedirection.title: Power Redistribution Complete
text: You successfully redirect power from non-essential systems. The station hums with renewed energy.
Life support stabilizes for now, but you're acutely aware this is only a temporary measure. Longer-term problems remain.

distressCall.title: Distress Signal Transmitted
text: Your distress call broadcasts across all channels. For long moments, there is only silence and the hum of dying systems.
Then, a response crackles through the static—a rescue vessel is en route. Estimated time: 6 hours. You must keep the station alive until then.

stabilizedStation.title: Equilibrium Achieved
text: The station settles into a stable state. Alarms quiet, and the frantic pace of disaster management gives way to careful monitoring.
You've managed to keep critical systems running. The immediate crisis has passed, but resources remain limited.

perfectBalance.title: Optimal Synchronization
text: Through meticulous recalibration, you achieve something extraordinary. Every system operates at perfect efficiency.
The unknown signal begins to harmonize with the station's systems rather than interfere. It's almost... cooperative.
As you analyze the pattern, a clearer message emerges. The signal wasn't hostile—it was a beacon. A map. An invitation.

signalTakeover.title: Loss of Control
text: The unknown signal floods through every system. Your consciousness feels scattered, pulled in a thousand directions.
The station's AI cascades into failure as the signal establishes dominance. You can feel something else now—something vast and patient.
Your last coherent thought is a question: Is it hostile, or merely... curious?

oxygenDepletion.title: The Final Breath
text: The looser oxygen restrictions felt like relief at first. But you miscalculated how quickly reserves would deplete.
The air grows thin. Your vision blurs. Alarms scream silently in the distance as consciousness slips away.
In your fading moments, you realize the station's fate is sealed—and yours with it.

stationExplosion.title: Critical Overload
text: The reactor's output spirals beyond safe parameters. Feedback loops cascade through every connected system.
The core reaches critical mass. In the final moment before detonation, you understand the magnitude of your miscalculation.
A blinding flash. Then nothing.

rescue.title: Salvation Arrives
text: The rescue vessel docks perfectly with the station's emergency airlock.
A team of professionals pours in, taking control of the situation with practiced efficiency.
As you're led to safety, you look back at the station you fought so hard to save.
It's damaged, limping, but alive. And so are you.

trueEnding.title: First Contact
text: The signal guides you through a sequence of system reconfigurations. Each step feels intuitive, almost obvious in hindsight.
The station becomes a beacon of harmony. And then, through the void, you detect them: Other stations. Other beacons. A network.
You realize you've just activated something ancient—a failsafe, or perhaps an awakening.
The unknown signal resolves into a message, finally clear: 'Welcome. The silence is over.'
